description: This file defines the HomeActivity class for an Android TV weather application user interface. It manages the main screen, including views for current weather, forecast tiles, location selection dialog, focus animations, and data observation via a ViewModel.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: An Android FragmentActivity that displays weather information, manages focus and animations for TV remote navigation, and handles location selection dialogs.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, binds views, sets up animations, click handlers, observation, and loads initial data.

methods.name: bindViews
methods.description: Finds and assigns all view references by their IDs.

methods.name: setupClickHandlers
methods.description: Sets click listeners for location buttons to prompt location selection.

methods.name: setupFocusAnimations
methods.description: Sets focus change animations for various focusable views to enhance TV navigation.

methods.name: observeViewModel
methods.description: Sets LiveData observers to update UI components based on weather data, location, and error states.

methods.name: showLocationDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog allowing user to select a location, updating the ViewModel accordingly.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key events such as back navigation.
